data.summary: Beispielvita Expat Health AG asks Kwame Asante to send a certificate of enrolment for the winter semester 2026/27 by 11 January 2027 to keep the student rate on policy BV-EXP-40917. If it does not arrive in time, the policy will be switched to the standard rate from February 2027.
data.explanation: This insurer letter says your health insurance is on a cheaper student rate, which only continues if you prove each semester that you are still enrolled. Send them the enrolment certificate (Immatrikulationsbescheinigung) for the winter semester 2026/27 before the stated deadline. If you miss it, your premium will move to the more expensive standard rate starting February 2027. This is not a legal deadline from an authority, just the insurer's own condition, so no objection rights apply here.
